name: God
description: A god is a major deity in a specific religion. While some religions may contain many gods and revere them more or less equally, others may focus their faith into a specific one, while others still may deny the existance of other gods besides their own.

name: Nyambe
description: $nyambe_god$ is the main [gods|e] and Sky Father for many [ShowLanguageFamilyName('bantu_language_family')] speaking people.

name: Nhialic
description: $nhialic_god$ is the main [gods|e] of the [ShowReligionAdjective('muonyjang_religion')] pantheon.

name: Du Chie
description: $du_chie_god$ is a creator god for the [ShowLanguageName('dinka_language')] speaking people.

name: Ayum
description: $ayum_god$ is the winds goddess of the [ShowLanguageName('dinka_language')] speaking people.

name: Alwet
description: $alwet_god$ is the goddess of the rain of the [ShowReligionAdjective('muonyjang_religion')] pantheon.

name: Zanahary
description: $zanahary_god$ creator god and sky father of the [ShowReligionAdjective('fomba_gasy_religion')] pantheon.

name: Ratovantany
description: $ratovantany_god$ is an earth god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('fomba_gasy_religion')] pantheon that made a pact with [ShowGodName('zanahary_god')] to create humanity.

name: Andrianerinerina
description: $andrianerinerina_god$ is the son of [ShowGodName('zanahary_god')] and founder of the royal line.

name: Andriambahomanana
description: $andriambahomanana_god$ is the first man in the [ShowReligionAdjective('fomba_gasy_religion')] pantheon.

name: Andriamahilala
description: $andriamahilala_god$ is the first woman in the [ShowReligionAdjective('fomba_gasy_religion')] pantheon, who choose to die and be reborn each month and became linked to the moon.

name: Ngai
description: $ngai_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowCultureName('maasai_culture')] people.

name: Asis
description: $asis_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowLanguageName('kalenjin_language')] speaking people.

name: Ilat
description: $ilat_god$ is the god of thunder and rain.

name: Waaq
description: $waaq_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowLanguageName('east_cushitic_language')] speaking people.

name: Kaggen
description: $kaggen_god$ is the creator and trickster god and folk hero of many african tribes.

name: Hunntuattatteen
description: $hunntuattatteen_god$ is the wife of [ShowGodName('kaggen_god')].

name: Kagara
description: $kagara_god$ is a god of lightning and brother-in-law of $haunu_god$.

name: Haunu
description: $haunu_god$ is a god of lightning and brother-in-law of $kagara_god$.

name: Akuj
description: $akuj_god$ is the supreme being of the [ShowLanguageName('lotuko_language')] speaking people.

name: Anyame
description: $anyame_god$ is the supreme god and sky father of the [ShowCultureName('akan')] people.

name: Asase Ya
description: $asase_ya_god$ is the goddess of love, fertility and the earth of the [ShowCultureName('akan')] people.

name: Anansi
description: $anansi_god$ is a trickster god and folk hero of the [ShowReligionAdjective('akan_religion')] pantheon.

name: Tano
description: $tano_god$ is the gof of war of the [ShowReligionAdjective('akan_religion')] pantheon, he represents the Tano river.

name: Legba
description: $legba_god$ is a spirit of the crossroads, who grants communication to the spirit world.

name: Mawu
description: $mawu_god$ is god of the Moon and the creator god of all things together with his twin [ShowGodName('lisa_god')].

name: Lisa
description: $lisa_god$ is goddess of the Sun and the creator goddess of all things together with his twin [ShowGodName('mawu_god')].

name: Sakpata
description: $sakpata_god$ is the god of earth and disease of the [ShowReligionAdjective('vodun_religion')] pantheon.

name: Olorun
description: $olorun_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('isese_religion')] pantheon.

name: Olokun
description: $olokun_isese_god$ is the god of water and wealth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('isese_religion')] pantheon.

name: Obatala
description: $obatala_god$ is the creator on mankind in the [ShowReligionName('isese_religion')] religion.

name: Ori
description: $ori_god$ is the custodian of fate in the [ShowReligionName('isese_religion')] religion.

name: Egbesu
description: $egbesu_god$ is the god of justice of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ijaw_religion')] pantheon.

name: Amadioha
description: $amadioha_god$ is the god of thunder and lightning of the [ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')] pantheon.

name: Ikenga
description: $ikenga_god$ is the horned god of fortune.

name: Agwu Nsi
description: $agwu_nsi_god$ is the god of divination and healing.

name: Ogbunabali
description: $ogbunabali_god$ is the god of death of the [ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')] pantheon.

name: Takhar
description: $takhar_god$ is the god of justice and vengeance of the [ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')] pantheon.

name: Mindiss
description: $mindiss_god$ is the manatee shaped protector of th Fatick Region in the [ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')] pantheon.

name: Niparaya
description: $niparaya_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('pericu_religion')] pantheon.

name: U Blei Nong-thaw
description: $u_blei_nong_thaw_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ka_niam_khasi_religion')] pantheon.

name: Ulei Muluk
description: $ulei_muluk_god$ is the god of the state for the [ShowCultureName('khasi_culture')] people.

name: Ulei Umtang
description: $ulei_umtang_god$ is the god of drinking water of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ka_niam_khasi_religion')] pantheon.

name: Ulei Longspah
description: $ulei_longspah_god$ is the god of wealth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ka_niam_khasi_religion')] pantheon.

name: Marang Buru
description: $marang_buru_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('sarna_religion')] pantheon.

name: Dharti ayo
description: $dharti_ayo_god$ is the goddess of earth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('sarna_religion')] pantheon.

name: Kotan-kar-kamuy
description: $kotan_kar_kamuy_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ainu_religion')] pantheon.

name: Kamuy-huci
description: $kamuy_huci_god$ is the goddess of the hearth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ainu_religion')] pantheon.

name: Kim-un-kamuy
description: $kim_un_kamuy_god$ is the god of bears and mountains of the [ShowCultureName('ainu_culture')] people.

name: Rep-un-kamuy
description: $rep_un_kamuy_god$ is the god of the sea of the [ShowCultureName('ainu_culture')] people.

name: Baradeo
description: $baradeo_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowCultureName('gond')] people.

name: Nat Awal
description: $nat_awal_god$ is the goddess of fertility of the [ShowCultureName('gond')] people.

name: Aki Pen
description: $aki_pen_god$ is the village guardian of the [ShowReligionAdjective('koyapunem_religion')] pantheon.

name: Nat Awual
description: $nat_awual_god$ is the mother goddess of the village of the [ShowCultureName('gond')] people.

name: Phi of Heaven
description: $phi_heaven_god$ is the god of heavens of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.

name: Phi of Water
description: $phi_water_god$ is the god of water of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.

name: Phi of Earth
description: $phi_earth_god$ is the god of earth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.

name: Phi of Fire
description: $phi_fire_god$ is the god of all natural powers of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.

name: Bathoubwrai
description: $bathoubwrai_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('bathou_religion')] pantheon.

name: Mainao
description: $mainao_god$ is the goddess protector of the rice fields of the [ShowCultureName('map_bodo')] people.

name: Song Bwrai
description: $song_bwrai_god$ is a household god of the [ShowCultureName('bodo_culture')] people.

name: Bura Bagh Raja
description: $bura_bagh_raja_god$ is a household god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('bathou_religion')] pantheon.

name: Donyi
description: $donyi_god$ is the goddess of the Sun of the [ShowReligionAdjective('donyi_polo_religion')] pantheon.

name: Polo
description: $polo_god$ is the god of the Moon of the [ShowReligionAdjective('donyi_polo_religion')] pantheon.

name: Kine Nane
description: $kine_nane_god$ is the goddess of crops and prosperity.

name: Doying Bote
description: $doying_bote_god$ is the god of heaven.

name: Sumnima
description: $sumnima_god$ is the supreme god and Mother Earth of the [ShowCultureName('kirati_culture')] people.

name: Paruhang
description: $paruhang_god$ is the god of the sky of the [ShowReligionAdjective('kirat_mundhum_religion')] pantheon.

name: Yuma Sammang
description: $yuma_sammang_god$ is the supreme god and Mother Earth of the [ShowCultureName('limbu_culture')] people.

name: Pathian
description: $pathian_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowCultureName('zo_culture')] people.

name: Khuanu
description: $khuanu_god$ is the god of nature of the [ShowReligionAdjective('mizo_religion')] pantheon.

name: Pu Vana
description: $pu_vana_god$ is the god of thunder and lightning of the [ShowCultureName('zo_culture')] people.

name: Sakhua
description: $sakhua_god$ is the god of the family of the [ShowCultureName('zo_culture')] people.

name: Sky Deity
description: The $sky_god$ represents the omnipresent force that watches over and protects humanity.

name: Death Deity
description: The $death_god$ represents the invitable equalizer that patiently waits for all.

name: Earth Deity
description: The $earth_god$ represents the fruits of the soil that allow the growth of our people.

name: Water Deity
description: The $water_god$ represents the strength and rejuvenation brought by rain and river.

name: Creator Deity
description: The $creator_god$ represents the original creation spark that created humanity.

name: Fire Deity
description: The $fire_god$ represents the passion of a warm hearth together with the fury of a raging inferno.

name: Fertility Deity
description: The $fertility_god$ represents the caring and nurturing power of a mother.

name: War Deity
description: The $war_god$ represents the strength and creativity brought by conflict, but also its devastation and calamity.

name: Wind Deity
description: The $wind_god$ represents the freedom and wonder of youth.

name: Thunder Deity
description: The $thunder_god$ represents the immediacy and indiference of fate.

name: Zeus
description: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('zeus_god')] is the king of the Olympian gods, ruler of the sky, thunder, law, and cosmic order.

name: Aphrodite
description: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('aphrodite_god')] is the goddess of love, desire, beauty, and social harmony.

name: Poseidon
description: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('poseidon_god')] is the god of the sea, earthquakes, and the untamed forces of nature.

name: Hermes
description: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('hermes_god')] is the messenger of the gods, patron of trade, travel, and cunning.

name: Ares
description: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('ares_god')] is the god of war in its violent and destructive form.

name: Athena
description: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('athena_god')] is the goddess of wisdom, strategy, and disciplined warfare.

name: Gaṇeśa
description: $ganesha_god$ is a major [god|e] in [ShowReligionName('hindu')], usually represented with an elephant head and revered as a bringer of luck and wisdom.

name: Śiva
description: $shiva_god$ is one of the main [gods|e] of [ShowReligionName('hindu')], and the supreme being in [ShowPolicyName('shaivism')]. He is the patron of asceticism and yoga.

name: Śakti
description: $shakti_god$ is a major [goddess|e] in [ShowReligionName('hindu')], revered as the fundamental cosmic energy. She is worshiped as the supreme [goddess] or Devī in [ShowPolicyName('shaktism')], and many other [goddesses] are worshiped as different aspects of $shakti_god$. Some of them can even take many other forms themselves.

name: Viṣṇu
description: $vishnu_god$ is one of the main [gods|e] of [ShowReligionName('hindu')], and the main one in [ShowPolicyName('vaishnavism')]. He is regarded as the supreme being, manifesting himself on earth in the form of his ten [avatars|e].

name: Sūrya
description: $surya_god$ is the Sun [goddess|e] in [ShowReligionName('hindu')], and one of the main deities of [ShowPolicyName('smartism')].

name: Wiraqucha
description: [ShowGodName('viracocha')] is the creator god of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Inti
description: [ShowGodName('inti_god')] is the sun god of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Illapa
description: [ShowGodName('illapa_god')] is the god of rain and thunder of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Supay
description: [ShowGodName('supay_god')] is the god of the underworld for the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Mamaquilla
description: [ShowGodName('mamaquilla')] is the moon goddess of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Pachamama
description: [ShowGodName('pachamama')] is the Earth Mother of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Mama Qucha
description: [ShowGodName('mama_cocha')] is the goddess of sea of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Urpihuachac
description: [ShowGodName('urpihuachac_god')] is the mother of birds and fish for the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

name: Uscovilca
description: [ShowGodName('uscovilca_god')] is the creator god of the [ShowCultureName('chanka_culture')] people.

name: Chinchaycamac
description: [ShowGodName('chinchaycamac_god')] is the main god of the [ShowCultureName('chincha_culture')] people.

name: Tláloc
description: [ShowGodName('tlaloc_god')] is the rain god of the Mesoamerican pantheon.

name: Huītzilōpōchtli
description: [ShowGodName('huitzilopochtli_god')] is the solar and war deity of sacrifice for the people of [ShowLocationName('tenochtitlan')].

name: Quetzalcōātl
description: [ShowGodName('quetzalcoatl_god')] is the god of life, wind and wisdom in the Mesoamerican pantheon.

name: Tēzcatlīpohca
description: [ShowGodName('tezcatlipoca_god')] is the god of providence, the invisible and darkness in the Mesoamerican pantheon.

name: Xiuhtēcuhtli
description: [ShowGodName('xiuhtecuhtli_god')] is the god of fire in the Mesoamerican pantheon.

name: Cōātlīcue
description: [ShowGodName('coatlicue_god')] is the goddess of fertility in the Mesoamerican pantheon.

name: Tepeu
description: $tepeu_god$ is the sovereign god of the [ShowLanguageName('maya_language')] speaking people.

name: Huracán
description: $huracan_god$ is the god of wind and storms of the [ShowReligionName('mayan')] pantheon.

name: Hun-Hunahpú
description: $hunhunahpu_god$ is the god of fertility and the ballgame of the [ShowReligionName('mayan')] pantheon.

name: Óðinn
description: $odin_god$ is the Lord of the Aesir, who sacrificed one eye for wisdom, and hanged from the World Tree for nine days and nine nights to gain knowledge of the runes.

name: Þórr
description: $tor_god$ is a member of the Aesir, who is worshipped as the God of thunder, storms, protection and free people.

name: Týr
description: $tyr_god$ is a member of the Aesir, and is the feeder of wolfs, and the battle god.

name: Njörðr
description: $njord_god$ is the of the Vanir, father of $freyr_god$ and $freya_god$. He is worshipped in relation to the seafaring and fishing.

name: Freyr
description: $freyr_god$ is a member of the Vanir, and worshipped for good harvest, pleasure and peace.

name: Freyja
description: $freya_god$ is a member of the Vanir, and worshipped as the Goddess of love, beauty, fertility and seidr.

name: Kök Teŋri
description: [ShowGodName('tengri_god')] is the god of heaven of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

name: Umay
description: [ShowGodName('umay_god')] is the goddess of fertility of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

name: Ülgen
description: [ShowGodName('ulgen_god')] is the god of goodness of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

name: Erlik
description: [ShowGodName('erlik_god')] is the god of death and the underworld of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

name: Kayra
description: [ShowGodName('kayra_god')] is the god of creation of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

name: Bai Baianai
description: [ShowGodName('bai_baianai_god')] is the goddess of forests and wildlife of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

name: Ak Ana
description: [ShowGodName('ak_ana_god')] is the goddess of water of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

name: Mergen
description: [ShowGodName('mergen_god')] is the god of abundance and wisdom of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.
